non_claims.text: PDF extraction and normalized objects do not certify faithful mathematical recovery.
Accounting for an obligation does not solve it or prove the paper wrong.
Specialist diagnostics do not establish that code and paper express the same scientific model.
One document case cannot establish general error-detection recall or precision.
This function does not authorize source edits, publication, release, or scientific claim promotion.
DynareMCP is an optional specialist and is not required for non-Dynare papers.

obligations.description: Check algebra, calculus, transformations, and limiting cases.
Check definitions, indexing, symbol identity, and undefined notation.
Check dimensions, units, scales, frequencies, and measurement conventions.
Check timing, conditioning, information sets, and event order.
Check objectives, constraints, first-order conditions, and boundary cases.
Check probability, likelihood, normalization, support, and uncertainty language.
Check estimands, identification conditions, treatment definitions, and causal claim boundaries.
Check expansion points, retained order, linearization, and approximation domains.
Check aggregation, ownership, stock-flow identities, and decomposition.
Check algorithm steps, convergence, initialization, stopping, and numerical evidence.
Check whether claims are supported by the cited source, code, data, or displayed result.
Check missing definitions, equations, external dependencies, and reconstruction closure.
